subject: One-off promo bump for Acme Media (close push)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: One-off promo bump for Acme Media (close push)

Team — quick request as we push to close Acme this week. Short background: Acme Media has been on a 30-day trial (video-ad encoding use case). They surface a clear business case (projected $120k ARR first year) but procurement says their legal review + PO will take until next month. The CSM says product fit is solid.

Current ask: they are asking for a small conversion incentive to justify committing now vs waiting — proposed: $5k in service credit applied in the first month OR a 30-day trial extension + $2.5k credit. My recommendation: offer the $5k one-time credit (offsets risk for them) and require DocuSign credit addendum + PO within 14 days.

Why: this is in-region, referenceable, and expands to additional teams if we land them. Our calendar is tight; closing before month-end materially helps the Q2 number.

Attachments: Acme_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf (MAP), ACME-SOW-redline.docx (technical SOW with minor redlines).

Can finance and deals ops approve the $5k one-off? If so, I’ll send the addendum and a tightened MAP that notes acceptance window. If you prefer the reduced credit + marketing co-fund, flag that and I’ll coordinate.

Thanks,
Jonas 
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: One-off promo bump for Acme Media (close push)

+1 on the $5k option if finance can accept on the billing side. Two small asks before greenlight: 1) don't bake the credit into list price — record it as a one-time service credit (so ARR isn't impacted), 2) require that Emily signs the MAP and the credit addendum is countersigned in DocuSign within 14 days.

If procurement pushes for longer, we should hold to the end-of-July cut-off — don't extend the credit window beyond that. Also consider asking for a short reference quote in exchange for the credit.

Emily — thanks for the candid convo last week. Per our internal alignment, we can offer Acme Media a one-time $5,000 service credit to be applied to the first invoice if the contract (DocuSign addendum + signed MAP) is returned within 14 days of countersignature. Key points: 
- Credit is a one-time line item, does not reduce list ARR; it will be recorded as a promotional credit on invoice 1.
- Credit expires if the addendum is not countersigned within 14 days.
- We can include a short reference blurb from your marketing team if you’re open to it (optional).

Attached: Acme_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf and the credit addendum (DocuSign link below). Please ping procurement if you want us to route the addendum to them directly.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/ABCDEF123456
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/ACME-2026-Q2-045

If acceptable, I’ll route the DocuSign envelope and confirm with revenue ops so we can create the billing code.

Thanks,
Jonas
